zh.title: 美國空軍EC-130H電戰機完成最後飛行正式退役
zh.summary: 美國空軍EC-130H型電戰機完成最後飛行；由新一代EA-37B接替任務
body: 美國空軍（USAF）於2026年9月2日在亞利桑那州戴維斯-蒙森空軍基地完成EC-130H Compass Call電戰機的最後一次飛行任務，正式宣告該款服役逾40年的主力電子攻擊機退役。這次最後飛行標誌著該型機數十年第一線作戰任務的終結。
在最後的飛行任務中，EC-130H與接替其任務的新一代EA-37B Compass Call電戰機同台亮相。根據美國空軍第355聯隊發布的資訊，這是兩種新舊電戰機首次進行編隊飛行。戴維斯-蒙森空軍基地為第55電子戰群的所在地，該單位長期負責操作與管理美軍整個EC-130H機隊。
EC-130H型電戰機於1980年代初期開始服役，由C-130 Hercules運輸機深度改裝而成，總計改裝了14架機體。該型機主要用於干擾敵方的通信、雷達及導航訊號，並執行壓制敵方防空系統任務。第355聯隊指出，僅在過去20年間，EC-130H機組人員即已累積超過7萬6000小時的實戰飛行時數。
作為後繼機型的EA-37B電戰機採用灣流（Gulfstream）G550商務機為基礎平台，機上乘員數為9人，少於EC-130H所需的13人機組。在Compass Call任務轉移計畫下，舊款EC-130H上約70%的任務核心設備被直接轉移安裝至新機體上，以維持電戰能力的延續性。
在2027財政年度的預算申請中，美國空軍已提出6.6億美元預算申請，預計採購額外3架EA-37B，並計畫在2031年前再增購7架。若相關計畫獲得國會完全撥款，未來EA-37B機隊規模將達到22架，超過原先EC-130H機隊的14架規模。

en.title: US Air Force Retires EC-130H Compass Call After Final Flight in Arizona
en.summary: The US Air Force retired its EC-130H Compass Call fleet following a final flight in Arizona.
body: The United States Air Force officially retired its EC-130H Compass Call electronic attack aircraft following the platform's final operational flight on September 2, 2026. The historic final sortie took place at Davis-Monthan Air Force Base in Arizona, ending more than four decades of continuous service for the specialized military airframe.

During the final Arizona sortie, the EC-130H flew alongside its designated successor, the EA-37B Compass Call. According to official imagery and statements from the 355th Wing, this flight represented the first time both electronic warfare aircraft types flew together in formation. The 55th Electronic Combat Group, based at Davis-Monthan, operated the entire legacy EC-130H fleet throughout its service life.

Entering front-line military service in the early 1980s as a heavily modified variant of the C-130 Hercules transport, a total of 14 EC-130H airframes were produced. The specialized aircraft was developed to jam adversary communications, radar, and navigation signals, while also supporting the suppression of enemy air defenses. Aircrews operating the fleet accumulated more than 76,000 combat hours over the past two decades.

The replacement EA-37B aircraft is based on the Gulfstream G550 business jet platform and is operated by a crew of nine personnel, compared to the 13-person crew required for the EC-130H. Under the Compass Call Rehost program, approximately 70% of the mission equipment from the older EC-130H platform is being transferred directly to the new EA-37B airframes to preserve operational capabilities.

In its fiscal year 2027 budget submission, the Air Force requested $660 million to procure three additional EA-37B jets, alongside plans to acquire seven more through 2031. If Congress fully funds these budget requests, the Air Force plans to expand the overall EA-37B fleet to 22 aircraft, surpassing the original 14-aircraft footprint of the retired EC-130H platform.

zh.title: DHL與樟宜機場（SIN）合作打造醫療保健冷鏈物流樞紐
zh.summary: DHL全球貨運於新加坡樟宜機場設立醫療冷鏈樞紐，預計2027年底完工。
body: 樟宜機場（SIN）集團（CAG）宣布，DHL全球貨運（DHL Global Forwarding）將於新加坡樟宜機場設立專用的醫療保健物流設施「DHL新加坡冷鏈樞紐」（DHL Singapore Coldchain Hub）。該設施將位於樟宜航空貨運中心的 Changi Nexus One 大樓內，預估將於2027年底前完工啟用。
該座占地 3,047 平方公尺的物流樞紐將依照優良分銷規範（GDP）標準建造，旨在維護經過新加坡及周邊地區醫療貨物的完整冷鏈。設施將配置符合 GDP 資格的冷藏室、即時溫度監控系統，以及直通空側的運送能力，提供從航機至設施再到客戶倉庫的全程溫控運輸解決方案，支援 2°C 至 8°C 與 15°C 至 25°C 的控溫貨物需求。
該設施所在的 Changi Nexus One 為一座物流建築，提供近 8,000 平方公尺的倉儲空間與停機坪直連設施，並為樟宜機場首座獲得 BCA 綠建標章白金級（BCA Green Mark Platinum）與白金級正能源建築認證的建築物。新樞紐將補充樟宜機場既有溫控設施，包含溫控拖車與超過 9,000 平方公尺的空側溫控處理能力，該等設施每年支援超過 37.5 萬噸貨物。
此項新投資屬於敦豪集團（DHL Group）在「2030策略」計畫下向其 DHL 醫療保健物流部門承諾的 20 億歐元（約 22 億美元）投資的一部分，旨在透過擴建基礎設施與專業解決方案推動全球生命科學及醫療保健領域的成長。
敦豪全球貨運新加坡、馬來西亞暨印度尼西亞執行長 Praveen Gregory 表示，亞太地區對生物製劑與特種藥品的需求正在增加，該樞紐對滿足未來供應鏈需求至關重要。樟宜機場集團空運樞紐與貨運發展執行副總裁 Lim Ching Kiat 則強調，該設施深化了雙方長期合作夥伴關係，並有助於發揮樟宜機場在航空連通性與專門貨運處理方面的優勢。

en.title: DHL Global Forwarding to Build Healthcare Cold Chain Hub at Changi Airport (SIN)
en.summary: DHL Global Forwarding will build a healthcare cold chain facility at Singapore Changi Airport by late 2027.
body: Changi Airport (SIN) Group (CAG) has announced that DHL Global Forwarding will establish a dedicated healthcare logistics facility, named the DHL Singapore Coldchain Hub, at Singapore's Changi Airport. The new facility will be located at Changi Nexus One within the Changi Airfreight Centre and is targeted for completion by the end of 2027.

Spanning 3,047 square meters, the hub will be designed in accordance with Good Distribution Practice (GDP) standards to handle healthcare and life sciences shipments requiring controlled temperatures of 2°C to 8°C and 15°C to 25°C. It will feature GDP-qualified cold rooms, direct airside connectivity, real-time temperature monitoring, and dedicated temperature-controlled transfer solutions operating from aircraft to the facility and onwards to customer warehouses.

The hub will be situated inside Changi Nexus One, an air logistics building offering close to 8,000 square meters of warehousing space and direct apron connectivity for accelerated cargo handling. Changi Nexus One is the first building at Changi Airport to achieve both BCA Green Mark Platinum and Green Mark Platinum Positive Energy Building certifications. The facility will complement existing airport infrastructure, which includes cool dollies and over 9,000 square meters of airside temperature-controlled handling capacity supporting more than 375,000 tons annually.

This investment forms part of DHL Group's broader 2 billion euro (2.2 billion US dollars) commitment to its DHL Health Logistics division under its Strategy 2030 plan. The broader strategy targets growth in the life sciences and healthcare sectors by expanding infrastructure, specialized cargo solutions, and global logistics capabilities.

Praveen Gregory, CEO of DHL Global Forwarding for Singapore, Malaysia, and Indonesia, noted that regional healthcare supply chains are evolving rapidly amid growing demand for biologics and specialty medicines, making the new hub essential for future supply chain resilience. Lim Ching Kiat, Executive Vice President of Air Hub and Cargo Development at Changi Airport Group, added that the project deepens a longstanding partnership while leveraging Changi's air connectivity and cargo handling capabilities.
